brief: As the Camden Works transformer has an ONAN cooling type, apply the cooling capacity and ambient de-rating rules set out in MG-021. Check for outstanding vegetation or obstruction defects, as SOP-011 dictates that clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity when a unit is identified for pre-event attention. If there is an open sampling defect, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 until the work is complete and the retest has returned within specification, as required by SOP-013. Record every de-rating applied and the resulting action against the asset per MG-021 and SOP-013.
